question: Which sequence of letters constitutes the seventh ritual placement?
premises: Letters beginning with the śrī-seed are to be placed
The sequence runs from a to kṣa
inference: The seventh nyāsa consists of placing the letters from a to kṣa beginning with the śrī-seed.
plain_english: One should place the letters beginning with the śrī-seed, from a to kṣa; this is the seventh placement.
